title: Learning Topological Features of $\widehat Z$-invariants
abstract: arXiv:2608.18570v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Machine learning and data analysis techniques have recently emerged as powerful tools for identifying patterns and formulating conjectures in mathematical research, most notably in the field of low-dimensional topology. In this paper, we initiate a systematic approach to handling mathematical data structured as (truncated) infinite $q$-series, or equivalently, infinite series of integers. To apply this data analysis pipeline, we construct a comprehensive dataset of $\widehat{Z}$-invariants (homological blocks) for plumbed 3-manifolds. We demonstrate that neural networks can reliably extract essential topological information, such as homology class and underlying graph structure, directly from the $q$-series coefficients. translated_title: 学习$\widehat Z$-不变量的拓扑特征
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.18570v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：机器学习和数据分析技术最近已成为数学研究中识别模式和提出猜想的有力工具，尤其是在低维拓扑领域。在本文中，我们开创了一种系统性的方法，用于处理以（截断的）无限$q$-级数或等价于整数无限级数形式构建的数学数据。为了应用这一数据分析流程，我们构建了一个全面的$\widehat{Z}$-不变量（同调块）数据集，用于带环3-流形。我们证明，神经网络能够直接从$q$-级数系数中可靠地提取基本拓扑信息，如同调类和底层图结构。我们方法论的核心特点是注重可解释性；通过对比局部梯度敏感性与全局特征相关性，我们揭示了网络学习到的是绕过复杂拓扑规则，而倾向于更简单模式的方式。
tldr: 本文提出了一种系统性方法，利用神经网络从$\widehat{Z}$-不变量的$q$-级数系数中提取拓扑特征，并强调可解释性以揭示网络学习模式。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a systematic approach to extract topological features from $q$-series coefficients of $\widehat{Z}$-invariants using neural networks, with a focus on interpretability to reveal learned patterns.
